title: Toronto Day Trip from Niagara Falls
includes: Pickup from Skylon Tower in Niagara Falls
Return shuttle service to Niagara Falls
Round-trip transportation between Niagara Falls and Toronto
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the vibrant streets of Downtown Toronto with a convenient day trip from Niagara Falls. Enjoy round-trip shuttle service and have approximately five hours to discover Toronto at your own pace. Visit iconic sites like the CN Tower, wander through the Distillery District, or indulge in world-class dining at your own pace. This flexible tour allows you to create your own itinerary while enjoying comfortable small-group transportation. Return to Niagara Falls relaxed after a day of adventure.

- Convenient round-trip shuttle from Skylon Tower to downtown Toronto
- Approximately 5 hours of free time to explore at your leisure
- Visit attractions like the CN Tower and Harbourfront
- Comfortable small-group transportation for a stress-free journey
